coverage.overview_method: Primary assistant inspected every page on rendered contact sheets for layout, page boundaries, missing content, tables and figures.

observations: No clipping, overlaps, missing pages, or unexpected empty pages in the full-document overview.
Independent readable-resolution review found no blocking issue in changed and adjacent pages.
All new tables, figure labels, captions, comparison signs, references and publication identifiers are legible.
limitations: Unchanged historical pages were inspected at overview scale for layout; the independent detailed page review covers the specified changed and adjacent pages, not a fresh scientific replication.
